entries.zh: 猛然闖入；突然進入；突進
entries.en: to rush in; to enter suddenly

entries.zh: 寄交；託寄（託人帶去交付）
entries.en: to entrust for delivery; to send by someone's hand
entries.notes: L 栏「Entregar g para le –」缩写残损，M 第二音节「lô」未详，据 H「寄」定託寄义。

entries.zh: 交付；交給（把東西交到對方手裡）
另行交付；把另帶之物分開交出
entries.en: to deliver (something) carried separately; to hand over apart
entries.notes: M 栏「momīndas」语义未明，据 L「llebado aparte」与 H「付」定另交义。

entries.en: to entrust; to commit to someone's keeping
entries.notes: M「cog」/R「lô」与 H「托」不对应，疑栏位错置；T99 污损，义据 H 与 L 推定。

entries.en: to deliver into someone's hand; to hand over personally
to hand over in person, hand to hand

entries.zh: 交卸；移交船貨財物（champan 華商帆船之貨載）
entries.en: to hand over the cargo/property of the champan (Chinese trading junk); to surrender one's charge
to give back; to return (what was delivered)

entries.zh: 卸任交印；任滿移交官印
entries.en: to hand over the seal of office at the end of one's term

entries.zh: 說書；講述本事（戲中說白段子）
entries.en: to tell a story; to perform a spoken interlude (entremés)
entries.notes: L 栏「Entremes sin can par」残缺，据 H「說本事」定说书叙事义。

entries.zh: 插手；凡事都要插手干預
entries.en: to meddle; to poke into everything
entries.notes: T99 污损；H「泰口」疑为「插手/插嘴」，M「chapa chūy」合之，R 栏不合。

entries.en: to butt in; to interrupt with talk
entries.notes: T99 污损；H「泰吉」疑为「插嘴」，M「chapa chy」合之，R 栏不合。

entries.en: to chat and laugh; to pass the time in talk
to grieve; to become sorrowful; to be vexed
entries.notes: L 末「g mrite」疑为缩写或残损未详；H「患」与 M「hūan, hūân lô（煩惱）」定忧伤义。
